annotations.title: FXRate: Exchange rates for one base currency

description:
All ECB reference exchange rates for a base currency (default EUR), or only the listed quotes, latest or on a past date. Free: 30 calls/day per IP, then $0.001 per call.

[FXRate via YourAITools MCP Hub] Free tier: same as FXRate's own MCP server (call without payment and without tier). Paid: rates $0.001 per call, with a credits key (Authorization: Bearer yatc_...) or x402 (USDC; the hub returns the payment terms). Failed tool calls aren't charged: credits are refunded automatically and x402 payments only settle on success.

base.description: Base currency (default EUR): ISO 4217 code, e.g. USD, EUR, GBP, JPY (31 supported)

date.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD (default: latest). Weekends/holidays use the previous ECB rate.

tier.description: Paid tier: rates $0.001. Omit tier (with no credits key or x402 payment) to use the free tier.
